sentence: This project uses 3D printing and artificial intelligence to make and control soft, fiber-reinforced actuators.
This project builds a soft robot that grows from its tip and carries sensors to inspect pipes for faults.
This project uses structured sound waves to move objects and to study how droplets, powders and biological cells organize themselves.
This project builds a security framework that protects vehicles talking to each other and to roadside infrastructure from attacks.
This project designs hybrid materials for medical devices that use electric signals to keep bacteria from forming biofilm.
This project brings researchers together to discuss how organic matter on Earth is made, cycled, changed and preserved.
This project builds a membrane-based way to purify viral vectors and virus-like particles used in gene therapy and vaccines.
This project studies how a mechanical toe can help humanoid robots walk and run more efficiently, using imitation learning.
This project studies a tool called the harmonic chain barcode that finds the shape of data, such as holes and voids.
This project maintains a database of earthquakes and other seismic events collected from institutions in many countries.
This project studies how African acacia trees have changed over time and how they respond to fire, drought and plant competition.
This project builds machine learning models that predict how vegetation across the globe responds to climate and how sure those predictions are.
This project uses remote sensing and plant monitoring to study how coastal marshes and forests shift as sea level rises.
This project studies how the endangered salt marsh harvest mouse bites, climbs and swims, and how its body form suits its wetland environment.
This project studies how droughts and heatwaves change how much water pecan trees use and how well they grow.
This project builds materials from polypeptides that are both clear and tough by controlling how the polypeptide chains are connected.
